reference.source: Actual independently repeated public Source counterparts for three established Native contracts. Main original Source observations remain in their original frozen file; no view or raw field corrections.
reference.phaseControl: Public requestAnimationFrame callbacks advance explicitly. Own-node Animations are paused on discovery and sampled with explicit currentTime followed by one public render frame. All snapshots preserve actual DOM/CSS, including before/start/active, no-CSS stalls and Source lifecycle quirks.

counterparts.description: Public React Context provider and panel useContext label consumer update through PopupContent.memo, mirroring the established live Svelte snippet contract.

Public outer ConfigProvider theme.token.motion=false preinstalls the inner motion provider while the inner TreeSelect starts with motion=true. Later inner motion changes retain root/editor/popup and bound state.
Public top-level style.height uses the independently published Native805 multiple-control heights32/60/32; numeric geometry comes from actual Source, never from computed expected corrections.
